capabilities: Collect all external links from the vault in one view
Group links by their source note with collapsible sections
Open links in the default browser on click
Exclude URLs and file paths via regex patterns
Open the view from the ribbon icon or command palette
problem: Obsidian's link panes focus on internal links, leaving no single view to browse external URLs scattered across notes.
summary: Side panel that collects every external URL in the vault, grouped by the note each link appears in.
